content.title: Is Your App Showing Incorrect Prayer and Sahri-Iftar Times for Your Area?
content.subtitle: Fix it right now by following two simple steps.
content.body:
For nearly a decade, showered with your love, Muslims Day has been serving as a trusted companion in every believer’s daily worship. Our primary goal is simple—to help a Muslim become a slightly better and more conscious believer today than yesterday. From the very beginning, our app has provided features to display prayer and Sahri-Iftar schedules according to the individual locations of millions of users worldwide. However, every now and then, many brothers and sisters reach out to let us know that the times are not showing correctly according to their current location. In this regard, to receive the accurate schedule based on local standards wherever you are, it is essential that two settings are set properly: your phone’s Time Zone and the app’s Location.

Why Are These Two Settings Essential?

The app primarily reads your device’s time zone and configured location to calculate the designated Sahri, Iftar, and prayer times for that area. Therefore, if your phone’s time zone is set to a different region or if an old location remains selected in the app, the timings for your current location will not be displayed accurately. To avoid this issue, we kindly request you to follow the two steps below:

First, Check If Your Phone’s Time Zone Is Correct

Quite often, slight discrepancies in the phone's internal clock or time zone lead to time differences in the app. How to fix it:

  • Go to your phone’s main Settings, and under System / Additional Settings, navigate to the Date & Time option.

  • Keep Set time automatically toggled on.

  • At the same time, enable both Set time zone automatically and Use location to set time zone so that your phone automatically maintains the standard time for your geographical region.

Next, Update the App’s Location and GPS

Once your phone’s clock is accurate, follow these steps so the app can identify your current location:

  • Pull down your phone’s notification bar and turn on Location (GPS).

  • Open the Muslims Day app and tap on the 'More' (Settings) option at the bottom right corner.

  • Tap on the 'Location' option located right at the top of Settings.

  • Now, tap the 'Set GPS Location' button, and the app will instantly detect your current location.

  • Finally, tap the 'Save' button at the bottom to store the information.
